summary: Core extended-precision floating-point remainder (x87 FPREM-style) reducer. Validates the control word of operand a2 (dword at a2+6 xored with 0x700), classifies both operands through the byte_5E74FC table and exponent masks (0x7FFF0000, excluding the all-ones and zero patterns), rejects operands whose low mantissa doubleword is zero, then reduces a5 modulo a2 either by repeated scaled subtraction (iteration count derived from the exponent-byte gap, divisor scaled by dbl_5E752C each step) or by direct x87 __FPREM__ when the exponent gap is at most 63. Finally reloads the x87 floating-point environment when the a1 flag has low bits set. Invoked from the FloatModulusWithDenormalHandling wrapper sub_5912BC.

local_names.a1: byte flag in dl whose low bits request an x87 environment reload
local_names.a2: first 80-bit operand (divisor); dword at a2+6 holds the control/exponent word
local_names.a5: second 80-bit operand (dividend); reduced by remainder operations in place
local_names.v6: iteration count for the scaled-subtraction loop
local_names.v7: fabs(divisor) value scaled by dbl_5E752C during the subtraction loop
local_names.v9: fabs(dividend) value reduced by subtraction under the FPU condition flag

operations.description: Seed result with the control word of operand a2 xored with 0x700: result = dword(a2+6) ^ 0x700.
Gate the whole reduction on the control-word check of operand a2: ((dword at a2+6) ^ 0x700) & 0x700 == 0 identifies a valid 80-bit long-double pattern; otherwise return early.
Derive a classification index: result = (xored control word >> 11) & 0xF.
Admit the operands only if the classification table byte_5E74FC at that index is non-zero.
Skip when a2's exponent field (dword at a2+6 masked with 0x7FFF0000) equals 0x7FFF0000 (infinity/NaN pattern).
Skip when a5's exponent field (dword at a5+6 masked with 0x7FFF0000) is 0 or equals 2147418112 (the 0x7FFF0000 infinity/NaN pattern).
Skip when a5's low mantissa doubleword is zero (2 * DWORD1(a5) == 0 marks an exact class needing no reduction).
Skip when a2's low mantissa doubleword is zero (2 * DWORD1(a2) == 0).
Branch on the exponent gap: if (a5 exponent, 0x7FFF mask) is greater than (a2 exponent, 0x7FFF mask) + 63 take the scaled-subtraction path, otherwise take the direct FPREM path.

Scaled-subtraction path: compute the iteration count from the exponent-byte difference (((expByte(a5) - expByte(a2)) & 0x3F | 0x20) + 1), take fabs(a2) and fabs(a5), then repeatedly subtract the divisor magnitude from the dividend magnitude while the FPU condition word lacks 0x100, scaling the divisor by dbl_5E752C each step until the count expires.
Direct path: while (a5 exponent, 0x7FFF mask) minus ((a2 exponent, 0x7FFF mask) + 10) is not negative, overwrite a5 with __FPREM__(a5, a2).

When the a1 flag has low bits set ((a1 & 3) != 0), capture the FPU status word (result = v13 & 0x4300) and reload the x87 floating-point environment (fnstenv/fldenv) so the caller observes the FPU state.
Return the accumulated result (FPU status/condition value or the classification table index path's result).
Invoked by the FloatModulusWithDenormalHandling wrapper sub_5912BC (0x005912BC), which passes a fast-path/scale flag in a1 and the two operands as bit patterns.
